scope: Official ACLGraphWrapper local-shard replay gate, frozen before device execution

vllm_ascend/attention/sfa_v1.py.contract: SFA actual_seq_lengths_key is the persistent GPU seq_lens tensor

vllm_ascend/attention/indexer.py.contract: LI/QLI consumes its independent GPU actual_seq_lengths_key

vllm_ascend/device/device_op.py.contract: Actual length tensors are passed to stock CANN operators without tolist on this path

csrc/attention/sparse_flash_attention/sp.contract: Official bridge passes the optional actual_seq_lengths_kv tensor to EXEC_NPU_CMD

vllm_ascend/compilation/acl_graph.py.contract: Actual mode dispatch, capture, weak output, and replay

vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py.contract: Official graph_capture creates a separate stream and waits for caller initialization

vllm_ascend/ascend_forward_context.py.contract: Actual Ascend forward context sets runtime mode, batch descriptor and capturing flag

vllm_ascend/utils.py.contract: SFA backend does not select the updatable graph branch

graph_contract.fixed_geometry: Exact M and 64 page-table columns; host max_seq_len=8192 is an upper bound
graph_contract.actual_lengths: GPU tensors and CPU mirrors updated to 8192-iteration%11
graph_contract.slots: Independent main/indexer INT32 producers; main persistent INT64 cache refreshed outside every replay; native captures live casts
graph_contract.cache_reset: Equal page-rolled base cache per iteration, restored before each of three arms
graph_contract.output_owner: Strong actual outer output retained in runnable before official wrapper weak alias conversion
graph_contract.execution_gates: Nonempty actual graph, capture counter +1, no captured-output read before replay, unchanged Python/native call counters on replay
graph_contract.reserve_gate: Default-stream warmup then actual inner capture stream recorded inside runnable; workspace and slot allocations must be claimed by identity on that stream
graph_contract.comparison: Vendor eager versus vendor wrapper replay versus native wrapper replay; final output, ordered topk and complete caches, raw-byte equality
graph_contract.consumption_witness: Per-iteration SHA, finite and nonzero count; dynamic actual lengths and output hashes must vary
graph_contract.replay_order: Vendor then native, matching capture order in the shared platform graph pool

library_selection: Explicit CLI paths to independent O combined candidate; default accepted libraries are unchanged

torch_npu_graph_source.contract: Without explicit stream, the actual graph context uses its class default capture stream, not the outer worker context stream
